shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/recreation/modded-needs, power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade/launch world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection; foreign types never in signatures. Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies, never guessed.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = 90t x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- T9 utility links: conduit (Power/Electricity), water pipe (DBH patch-gated); utilityOnly excluded from pawn routing; per-def bridge flags.

## Sky surface model (round-10 final)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + sweep. Mountain cap in vanilla fog material clones; mined floors in rock edge color. Self-heal retry + ReconcileRooftops.

## See-below renderer (round-13, VERIFIED)
- Cloned section materials at runtime queues; Watergen excluded + lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() per frame = real vanilla water from above; mask = fog + baseDim only; one-way mirror dynamic pass.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest (bed ownership), food (incl. eligible pets), RECREATION (round 15: JobGiver_GetJoy postfix at LOW priority, virtual re-scan at exits, 600t cooldown), MODDED NEEDS (round 15: generic engine - LOW-priority postfix on BASE ThinkNode_JobGiver.TryIssueJobPackage + type-name registry; JobGiver_Work unaffected by override dispatch; empty-registry cost one static bool; inherits each mod's own think-tree gating; virtual scan + stairs commute + natural re-roll on arrival. Built-ins assembly-verified: RJW rjw.JobGiver_JoinInBed + rjw.JobGiver_DoQuickie (solo/hostile givers excluded by design), Intimacy LoveyDoveySexWithEuterpe.JobGiver_GetIntimacy. Public: ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver).
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; power/pipes/climate bridges; ABPendingOrders.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED)
- Diversion at execution (infestation relaxed finder + locOverride; drop raids validated); pocket incident redirect (DeepDrill exempt, ABIncidentLevelPolicy opt-in); pocket NPC scan (hostiles descend + assault-join; friendlies with exit duties incl. RegisterExitDuty get exit lords; never insects/vehicles).

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth (ON); cross-level caravans; column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction.

## T11 mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md, 1471 mods triaged)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes, DBH (+vertical pipe), Vehicle Framework (vehicles never routed), Hospitality (duty-safe), Common Sense (decompile-audited; shared joy seam via LOW priority), RJW (sex need cross-level via engine), Intimacy (intimacy need via engine), Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter.
- OK by audit: Hauler's Dream, Smarter Construction, Romance on the Rim (co-located dates; beds converge couples), Allow Tool/PUAH-class.
- INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded (active in user's real list - flagged). Watch: Perspective Shift, airship traders, Real Ruins, gravships.

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events LevelCreated/LevelRemoved/PawnTransferred; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver (modded-need migration).
- XML: ABStairsExtension (third-party links, full lifecycle); ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Performance architecture
- Plain-bool guards; AnySkyLevels gate; stairs memo. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t, sweep 2000t, NPC scan 250t pocket-only. Joy + modded-need migrations cost only on null scans behind 600t per-pawn cooldowns; need engine = one static bool per giver eval when registry empty. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip; no below water depth shading; mined-floor hard edges.
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs; couples-as-singles alert; RC + stuff picker direct links; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on; sweep-cadence wall edits.
- T8: mounted raiders never descend; basement insects stay; incidents never target pocket levels directly (API opt-out).
- World: caravan items surface-only; animals/prisoners not listed; purchases drop at surface; transporter loading surface-only; gravships untested.
- Needs: givers that override TryIssueJobPackage themselves are outside the engine; RotR dates co-located only.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 + threats + world DONE/verified. T11 compat (hauling/romance audit, recreation, modded-needs engine) + T12 API: IMPLEMENTED, pending smoke test (joy + RJW need migration with companion, API events, redirect).
- Next: T5 publishing prep. Backlog: VEF per-net shafts via API, caravan items/animals, RotR date summons, watch-list verifications.

## Status
Round-15 complete: recreation + generic modded-needs migration engine (RJW/Intimacy built-ins, assembly-verified names). Compiling. T5 publishing prep next.
